title: NeuroMetBench reproducibility package
description: NeuroMetBench is a patient-aware evidence-bounding methodology for evaluating transcript-derived metabolic representations across heterogeneous proteogenomic contexts. Version 2.1.1 adds a machine-readable current article claim-evidence ledger, clarifies the cohort-conditional interpretation of BSL02 bootstrap intervals, strengthens closed-world reproducibility checks, updates the separately versioned neurometbench-ref helper software to 1.0.2 with validation-only corrections, and embeds the exact immutable v2.0.7 historical archive. Frozen article-level scientific estimates, adverse results, and claim ceilings are unchanged.
